description: Ordered API observations of an operation that starts in a surface view page. An operation step calls runtime.beginOperation(event, fields) and stores its returned cids under as. A sidecar step calls runtime.sidecar(name).send(id, body, cids) and a command step calls runtime.command(name, params, {cids}); cids names a stored list. A log observation is the first plugin event delivered by the page writer, independent of its clock and batch transport. A request observation is a non-log API call with its transport id omitted. The surface writer accepts only runtime.log requests with action clock or batch; its clock sampling, lifecycle records and timestamps are specified and verified by the logging writer owners. Each step lists log or request, result and throws. Identifiers use p$ORIGIN.<n>, where $ORIGIN is the time origin of the test page. The page is soksak://probe/.
